steps.instruction: Grease and flour a 9-inch round cake pan.
Whisk 2 cups of flour and 1 1/2 teaspoons of baking powder in a medium bowl.
Whisk in 1/2 teaspoon each of baking soda, salt and ground cinnamon.
Cream 1/2 cup of softened butter and 1 cup of sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in 2 eggs, one at a time.
Beat in 1 1/2 teaspoons of vanilla extract.
Add 3 mashed ripe bananas and mix until well combined.
Add the flour mixture a little at a time, alternating with 1/2 cup of buttermilk.
steps.spoken: Add the flour mixture a little at a time, alternating with 1/2 cup of buttermilk. Begin and end with the flour mixture. Mix just until combined after each addition. Be careful not to overmix.

steps.instruction: Pour the batter into the cake pan.
Smooth the top with a spatula.

steps.spoken: Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, until a toothpick put into the center of the cake comes out clean.

steps.instruction: Let the cake cool in the pan for 10 minutes.
steps.spoken: Take the cake out of the oven. Let it cool in the pan for about 10 minutes.

steps.instruction: Move the cake to a wire rack to cool completely.
